memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The descendants of Benjamin by their clans were... those numbered were 45,600. The descendants of Dan by their clans were... The descendants of Asher... The descendants of Naphtali... those numbered were 45,400. - Num 26:38-50 (NIV, abridged)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The census gathers up the remaining tribes: Benjamin, Dan, Asher, and Naphtali, each counted by their clans. With these, the roll of Israel is nearly complete. Every tribe has been accounted for, every family numbered, the whole people set in order before the Lord as they prepare to receive their inheritance.

It would be easy to grow weary of these repeated lists. Yet their very repetition tells us something. God was thorough. He did not overlook a single tribe or leave any family uncounted. His care extended to all of them, from the greatest to the least. Nothing about His people escaped His attention.

This thoroughness reflects the heart of God. He is not careless or forgetful with those who belong to Him. Every one of these families was known, valued, and prepared for the future He had planned. The God who counts so carefully is the God who watches over His people with unfailing attentiveness.

We can rest in this same care. The Lord who numbered every tribe of Israel knows even the hairs on our heads (Luke 12:7). Nothing about your life is too small for His notice. In Christ, you are fully known and fully loved, held in the attentive care of a God who overlooks nothing. Take comfort in His thorough, faithful love.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. How does God's thorough care for Israel comfort you?
2. Do you believe nothing about your life escapes God's notice?
3. What worries can you entrust to a God who overlooks nothing?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You overlook nothing and no one who belongs to You. You know even the smallest details of my life. Help me rest in Your thorough and faithful care through Christ. Amen.
